prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Charlotte NC?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” tanning salon in Charlotte — the right choice depends on what you want (spray tan vs UV bed), your neighborhood, budget, and priorities (speed, privacy, cleanliness, organic spray solutions, etc.). I don’t have live web access to pull current local ratings, but I can help you pick the best salon for you. Quick options:

1) Quick question so I can give tailored recommendations
- Do you want a spray/airbrush (sunless) tan or a UV tanning bed?
- Which area of Charlotte are you nearest to (Uptown, South End, Ballantyne, South Charlotte, University, etc.)?
- Any preferences: cheap, luxury, private booths, organic solutions, same-day appointments?

2) How to identify the best salon (use these when you search Google/Yelp)
- Reviews: look for many recent 4–5 star reviews and photos.
- Technician training: ask whether techs are certified in airbrush/spray techniques and what brand they use (e.g., Versa, Mystic).
- Cleanliness and maintenance: booths, tools and communal areas should look well-kept.
- Before/after photos: good salons show consistent results on varied skin tones.
- Patch test / consultation: reputable places will offer a patch test or at least a consultation for first-timers.
- Transparent pricing & options: clear pricing for levels of color, add-ons (exfoliation, bronzer), and maintenance products.

3) My strong recommendation
- For safety and best-looking, natural results, choose a professional spray/airbrush tan from a certified technician rather than UV beds. UV increases skin cancer risk and premature aging.

4) Spray tan prep and aftercare (short)
- Prep: exfoliate and remove lotions/makeup; wear loose dark clothing and avoid deodorant/lotions right before the appointment.
- Aftercare: avoid showering/bathing/working out for 6–8 hours (follow tech’s instructions), moisturize daily, and use sulfate-free products to extend the tan.

If you tell me which neighborhood you’re in or paste 2–3 salon names you’re deciding between, I’ll compare what to ask them and what to expect so you can pick the best one.
